source.excerpt: Shared as a way through the drug-cost maze for a family facing an oncology bill they cannot absorb.

body:
## What it does

Oncology medication can arrive with a price no household has planned for. This goes looking for the charitable funds and manufacturer schemes that would cover part of it, puts you in line for word when a dry fund opens again, and drafts the forms. It never asks for your national ID or chart numbers. It runs when you ask it to, rather than on a timer.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @MSaintjour shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
